description: IDEX Corporation is a global applied solutions provider serving niche markets with mission critical components for everyday life, with substantially all of its business activities carried out through over 50 wholly-owned subsidiaries with shared values of Trust, Team and Excellence, and a diverse family of businesses committed to making trusted solutions that improve lives and that is innovative and inquisitive in its quest to solve customers' most challenging applied technology problems. These businesses operate with a high degree of autonomy, yet are all united by employing The IDEX Difference, a philosophy of great teams that embrace the 80/20 principle while remaining hyper-focused on serving customers, and it was incorporated in Delaware on September 24, 1987.
